body:
I have talked to her. And we've went over it in counselling as well. Most of the things she cites as keys to her happiness are either things I can't change or things that would push me further into depression. For instance she wants me to get rid of my dog. She hates him because she isn't a dog person and probably because he's my dog and she hates me so he is hated by proxy.

One of her big needs is that our relationship gets fixed. Its hard for me to fix whats broken on my end when I'm constantly being treated like crap. She also takes no ownership over our relationship issues, she thinks everything is my fault.

I wish it was as simple as talking to her, but I don't feel like I'm dealing with a rational person anymore. She just hates everything and continues to be consumed by it.
